tagline: KMZ数码单反相机，1965 年发布
description: KMZ于1965年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度focal plane textile shutter, speeds 1/30 up to 1/500 sec. + B, synchronized at 1/30th (variable delay, X through M).。使用35mm, with speeds 16 to 500 ASA。

specs.卡口: M39 Zenit mount (z39), then M42 screw mount without aperture coupling.
specs.快门: focal plane textile shutter, speeds 1/30 up to 1/500 sec. + B, synchronized at 1/30th (variable delay, X through M).
specs.取景器: pentaprism finder, diopter correction lens mountable
specs.自拍: with own release button and 15 sec. delay-time
specs.英文简介: The Zenit E is a Soviet 35mm SLR camera.
